purpose: Reversible derived musical-style neighborhoods over immutable Gemini labels; no production score activation.

input_reference.scope: Vocabulary design informed by the connector-returned frozen100 export. Full source CSV is not bundled and no new audio listening or accuracy audit was performed.

hip_hop.label: Hip Hop
hip_hop.definition: Hip-hop-derived musical styles, including vocal rap and instrumental forms. Never infer foreground rapping from this family alone.

rnb_soul.label: Rnb Soul
rnb_soul.definition: R&B and soul traditions, including contemporary, alternative and neo-soul branches. Not all singing is R&B.

pop.label: Pop
pop.definition: Pop songwriting and its established stylistic branches. Does not mean every popular recording.

electronic.label: Electronic
electronic.definition: Electronic musical traditions. A synthesizer or electronic production tag alone does not make a song a genre member; electronic does not imply dance-floor function.

rock.label: Rock
rock.definition: Rock and related stylistic branches. Guitar presence alone is insufficient.

folk.label: Folk
folk.definition: Explicitly identified folk traditions or folk styles. Acoustic timbre alone is insufficient; do not collapse unrelated traditions into one usable playlist.

jazz.label: Jazz
jazz.definition: Jazz-derived musical styles. A jazz sample alone need not make an entire recording jazz.

blues.label: Blues
blues.definition: Explicit blues styles and traditions, distinct from generic sad mood.

funk.label: Funk
funk.definition: Funk-derived groove styles. Keep separate from generic R&B; cross-memberships are allowed.

classical.label: Classical
classical.definition: Classical and explicitly identified contemporary classical styles. Soundtrack use and piano instrumentation alone are insufficient.

country.label: Country
country.definition: Country and country-derived styles. Acoustic guitar alone is insufficient.

reggae.label: Reggae
reggae.definition: Reggae-derived styles, with explicit substyles retained rather than one Caribbean bucket.

rnb_soul.label: R&B / soul
rnb_soul.definition: Contemporary R&B, alternative R&B, neo-soul and explicit R&B/soul hybrids; preserves a common neighborhood across substyles.

boom_bap_jazz_hop.label: Boom bap / jazz-hop
boom_bap_jazz_hop.definition: Sample-oriented hip-hop and jazz-rap stylistic territory. Does not require or forbid lead rap.

lofi_chillhop.label: Lo-fi / chillhop
lofi_chillhop.definition: Explicit lo-fi-beat and chillhop styles. Not a synonym for all hip-hop instrumentals or all low-fidelity audio.

instrumental_hip_hop.label: Instrumental hip-hop
instrumental_hip_hop.definition: Explicit beat-led instrumental hip-hop styles, potentially energetic or experimental; not inherently lo-fi.

trap_cloud_rap.label: Trap / cloud-rap styles
trap_cloud_rap.definition: Trap and related cloud/melodic/emo rap territory. Retains each fine label; no assumption all such songs belong together.

downtempo_trip_hop.label: Downtempo / trip-hop
downtempo_trip_hop.definition: Downtempo, trip-hop and chillout stylistic territory; related to but not identical to lo-fi beats or ambient.

pop_song.label: Pop songwriting
pop_song.definition: Specific pop-song styles. Raw broad Pop alone does not activate this neighborhood in the conservative mapping.

indie_dream_pop.label: Indie / dream / bedroom pop
indie_dream_pop.definition: Indie-pop, dream-pop and bedroom-pop stylistic territory; distinct fine labels survive.

synthetic_pop.label: Synth / dance-pop
synthetic_pop.definition: Synth-pop, electropop and dance-pop; no automatic house/techno classification.

hyperpop_digital_pop.label: Hyperpop / digital pop
hyperpop_digital_pop.definition: Explicit hyperpop and reviewed digital-pop neighbors. Not generic ambient, fast music, electronic music, or all processed vocals.

house_disco.label: House / nu-disco
house_disco.definition: House variants and related contemporary disco production; full subtype identities retained.

techno.label: Techno
techno.definition: Techno variants, with minimal, dub, industrial and hard variants retained. This is not all electronic music.

trance.label: Trance
trance.definition: Explicit trance styles. Not implied by atmospheric synthesizers.

dnb_jungle.label: Drum-and-bass / jungle
dnb_jungle.definition: Drum-and-bass/jungle styles with fine subtypes such as neurofunk retained.

dubstep_bass.label: Dubstep / bass styles
dubstep_bass.definition: Explicit dubstep, future-bass and related bass styles. Broad Bass Music alone is too ambiguous for a confident fine relationship.

ambient_drone.label: Ambient / drone
ambient_drone.definition: Explicit ambient/drone music, rather than every atmospheric recording.

experimental_electronic.label: Experimental electronic
experimental_electronic.definition: Specific glitch/IDM/deconstructed electronic styles. Generic Experimental is a modifier and does not activate a universal cluster.

rock_alternative.label: Rock / alternative rock
rock_alternative.definition: Explicit rock-derived styles, with punk/metal/shoegaze labels retained, not collapsed into identical songs.

folk_acoustic_song.label: Folk / acoustic songwriting
folk_acoustic_song.definition: Explicit acoustic-pop and folk-songwriter styles, not any recording that contains acoustic instruments.

jazz.label: Jazz styles
jazz.definition: Explicit jazz styles; broad-only Jazz is display metadata until supported by more specific evidence.

blues.label: Blues styles
blues.definition: Explicit blues substyles; reserve until present in the corpus.

funk_disco.label: Funk / disco
funk_disco.definition: Specific funk/disco styles; not a synonym for danceable or soulful.

classical.label: Classical styles
classical.definition: Explicit classical substyles. Soundtrack and cinematic alone are excluded.

country_americana.label: Country / Americana
country_americana.definition: Explicit country and Americana styles, with finer identities preserved.

reggae_dancehall.label: Reggae / dancehall
reggae_dancehall.definition: Explicit reggae, dub and dancehall styles; not all Caribbean music.

afrobeats.label: Afrobeats
afrobeats.definition: Contemporary Afrobeats vocabulary. Distinct from Afrobeat, Afro house and the continent of Africa.

afrobeat.label: Afrobeat
afrobeat.definition: Explicit Afrobeat tradition; retain separately from contemporary Afrobeats.

bossa_nova.label: Bossa nova
bossa_nova.definition: Explicit bossa nova style. Not all Latin music or all jazz.

reggaeton.label: Reggaeton
reggaeton.definition: Explicit reggaeton style. Not any Spanish-language song.

composite_labels.rule: Broad combined catalog bucket; no specific dance neighborhood follows.
Explicit alias of the chosen broad R&B/soul family.
Preserve scene/form; do not infer R&B or acoustic production.
Broad catalog compound; no specific tradition or acoustic-song neighborhood follows.

membership_proposal.aggregation: coordinatewise maximum; aliases and overlapping parents never add duplicate votes
membership_proposal.self_reported_certainty: stored, not a calibrated probability or multiplicative confidence
membership_proposal.note: Weights are engineering proposals, not measured musical distances. Keep fine canonical labels alongside neighborhood profiles; do not claim identical neighborhood vectors establish compatibility.
membership_proposal.field_level_policy: Resolve concept type independently of source field: a specific style appearing in primary_family can contribute at the declared field strength. Broad family concepts remain context-only regardless of which field contains them.

requirements: do not activate without corrected-vs-damaged evaluation

S01.title: AllMusic: Genres, styles, moods and themes
S01.supports: Different metadata dimensions, not a universal distance scale.

S02.title: Discogs: Database Guidelines 9 — Genres / Styles
S02.supports: Broad genres, narrower styles, and combined genres.

S03.title: MusicBrainz: Genre
S03.supports: Subjective, community-maintained genre tags; vocabulary can expand.

S04.title: MusicBrainz: Genre list
S04.supports: Terminology reference, including contemporary styles. Does not supply calibrated distances or track truth.

S05.title: Bogdanov et al.: The AcousticBrainz Genre Dataset (ISMIR 2019)
S05.supports: Multi-source, multi-level, multi-label annotations and taxonomy disagreement.

S06.title: Native Instruments: What is boom bap?
S06.supports: Hip-hop production vocabulary; sampled/swinging kick-snare foundations.

S07.title: Ableton / Comakid: LoFi HipHop
S07.supports: Production texture and groove; lo-fi is not simply absence of vocals.

S08.title: Roland: Trap and Lo-Fi Beats
S08.supports: Related hip-hop styles with differing production tendencies.

S09.title: AllMusic: R&B styles
S09.supports: R&B, contemporary R&B, alternative R&B, soul and neo-soul relationships.

S10.title: AllMusic: Neo-Soul
S10.supports: Classic-soul-oriented branch related to contemporary R&B.

S11.title: AllMusic: Trip-Hop
S11.supports: Downtempo electronic and hip-hop relationships; related is not synonymous.

S12.title: AllMusic: Downbeat
S12.supports: Electronic listening music need not be dance-floor music.

S13.title: AllMusic: Ambient
S13.supports: Texture-focused atmospheric music, not a synonym for all experimental music.

S14.title: Splice: Hyperpop
S14.supports: Pop experimentation, synthetic production and dense processing; catalog ranges are not genre eligibility rules.

S15.title: Native Instruments: How to make future bass
S15.supports: Synth-heavy bass music and trap/dubstep influences; not equivalent to hard techno.

S16.title: Recording Academy: 2023 in review — K-pop
S16.supports: K-pop spans multiple sonic styles; retain scene/context separately.

S17.title: Native Instruments: Phonk music
S17.supports: Hip-hop lineage and differences between phonk variants.

S18.title: City Girl: Goddess of the Hollow (artist release page)
S18.supports: Artist-supplied album tags and recording credits. Album tags do not prove each track genre.

S19.title: MusicBrainz: Folksonomy Tagging
S19.supports: Tags can encode genre, nationality and other non-genre information.

S20.title: Oramas et al.: Multimodal Deep Learning for Music Genre Classification
S20.supports: Multi-label genre modeling; musical evidence can span multiple sources.

S21.title: Soundation: How to make lo-fi hip hop
S21.supports: Jazz/boom-bap overlap and the distinction between production and listening use.
